objectives: Repair a specific ay decoding or spelling error and check transfer on fresh examples.
Identify ay in taught words such as “day”.
Explain how ay represents long a in these examples.
Check accuracy by rereading the whole word or sentence.
concepts: ay represents long a in the taught word set.
A vowel team is read as a unit while consonants are blended.
Readers check the complete word and its meaning rather than relying on a first-letter guess.
Fresh examples help show transfer beyond memorised responses.

workedExamples.prompt: Read “day”. Which spelling is the target focus?
workedExamples.solution: The target spelling is ay; read the whole word using the taught sound long a.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner misreads “play”. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Identify ay, blend the complete word and reread to check the taught pronunciation.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
